name: Suflí (Spain)
description: White field with a green diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with a white disc outlined in black bearing a green mountain and a white wall.
history: Suflí was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía on 18 February 1997 to adopt its symbols but did not do so until ten years later; the flag is a rectangular white cloth of 1:2 crossed diagonally from the top of the hoist to the bottom of the fly by a green band one fifth of the width, with a black-edged white circle at the centre painted with a green mountain.

features.role: band one fifth of the width from the upper hoist to the lower fly
